sloka: ततः शक्तिं महाशक्तिर्दीप्तां दींप्ताशनीमिव ।विभीषणाय चिक्षेप राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ।। ६.१०१.१९ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śaktiṁ mahāśaktirdīptāṁ dīṁptāśanīmiva ।vibhīṣaṇāya cikṣepa rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān ।। 6.101.19 ।।

translations.english: Then, endowed with extraordinary energy, the powerful leader of Rakshasas hurled a flaming thunderbolt like javelin at Vibheeshana.
